name: Zhongji Innolight Co., Ltd. Class H
summary: Zhongji Innolight Co., Ltd. researches, develops, designs, manufactures and sells high-speed optical transceivers, with operations in China, the United States, Singapore, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and Hong Kong. Its portfolio ranges from 10G to 1.6T transceivers, including 400G, 800G and 1.6T modules, and also covers components used in optical communication equipment.
